youAreUsingThe: ✓ You are using the installed app. Nothing more to do.
soYouCanSend: So you can send voice messages. Tap the button and choose Allow.
theMicrophoneIsSwitched: The microphone is switched off. Tap the lock or sliders icon at the left of the web address, then Permissions, and allow the Microphone. No icon? Tap the three dots, then Settings, Site settings, Microphone. Then tap the button again.
theMicrophoneIsNot: The microphone is not allowed yet. Do step 1 first, or tap Install the app again to install without it.
itPutsSevenFriends: It puts Seven Friends on your home screen like any other app. It is free, needs no app store, and you can remove it any time.
anAppForYour: An app for your Windows computer: it runs next to the clock, so new messages arrive as notifications even when the window is closed.
openTheDownloadedFile: Open the downloaded file to install it. If Windows says it protected your PC, choose More info, then Run anyway.
theSevenFriendsApp: The Seven Friends app for your phone.
openTheDownloadedFile2: Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow your browser to install apps from this source, then tap Install. Then open Seven Friends from its icon and tap Allow when it asks for notifications and the microphone.
theAndroidAppIs: The Android app is not ready to download yet. Please try again later.
thisDeviceNeedsA: This device needs a few steps. Follow the ones for your device:
anIphoneHasNo: An iPhone has no "Install" button, so you put the app on your home screen yourself. It takes less than a minute.
openStrongSevenFriends: Open Seven Friends in Safari, the blue compass app. This does not work from inside another app's browser (Facebook, Instagram, mail), so if you got a link there, copy it and paste it in Safari.
tapTheStrongShare: Tap the Share button: a square with an arrow pointing up. It is at the bottom of the screen on an iPhone, and at the top right on an iPad.
scrollDownInThe: Scroll down in the list that opens and tap Add to Home Screen. If you do not see it, scroll further, or tap More or View More first.
youCanKeepThe: You can keep the name Seven Friends. If you are asked, leave Open as Web App switched on. Tap Add in the top right corner.
goToYourHome: Go to your home screen: the Seven Friends icon is there, like any other app. Open it from that icon, not from Safari. Only the icon opens it as an app.
signInAgainThe: Sign in again the first time. The app on the home screen keeps its own login, separate from Safari.
whenItAsksTo: When it asks to send you notifications, tap Allow, or your friends cannot reach you when the app is closed.
notificationsOnAnIphone: Notifications on an iPhone need iOS 16.4 or newer (Settings → General → Software Update shows your version). To change them later: Settings → Notifications → Seven Friends. To remove the app: press and hold the icon and choose Remove App.
openStrongSevenFriends2: Open Seven Friends in Chrome or Edge.
clickTheStrongInstall: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar (a screen with a small arrow), or open the browser menu and choose Install Seven Friends (Chrome: under Cast, save and share).
clickStrongInstallStrong: Click Install. The app opens in its own window and gets an icon in your app list.
safariOnAMac: Safari on a Mac: choose File → Add to Dock.
startItWhenYou: Start it when you sign in to your computer
afterInstallingYouCan: After installing, you can let the app start by itself so that notifications arrive without opening the browser.
strongEdgeStrongOpen: Edge: open edge://apps, press ⋯ on Seven Friends and choose Auto-start on device login.
strongChromeStrongOpen: Chrome: open chrome://apps, right-click Seven Friends and choose Start app when you sign in.
